cds.title: Oregon State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (pdf)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set G1 (2026-2027 academic year, 15 credits a term): in-state tuition $13,440, nonresident tuition $40,155, required fees $2,592, on-campus food and housing $19,011 (housing $13,311 + meal plan $5,700). G5 estimates: books and supplies $600, transportation $930, other expenses $2,958 (other costs shown = transportation + other). G4 says tuition and fees vary by program and 50.5% of full-time undergraduates pay more than the G1 amounts. CDS H6: institutional need-based and non-need-based aid is available to degree-seeking nonresidents; 361 nonresident undergraduates received it (average $8,996, need- and non-need-based combined)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class). C1 totals are the sums of the male/female/unknown-sex rows and agree with the residency rows (applied 8,610 + 20,412 + 340 = 29,362; admitted 7,199 + 15,849 + 124 = 23,172; enrolled 2,527 + 1,911 + 14 = 4,452). The residency rows were read from the PDF text in order (columns were shifted in the layout view). Non-binding early action, no early decision. Wait-list: 764 offered a place and 292 admitted; the number accepting is not printed. Test-optional: SAT/ACT percentiles cover only students who submitted scores; C9 prints 8% (532) for SAT and 4% (274) for ACT, and those percents and counts do not agree with each other against 4,452 enrollees, so the percents are shown as printed. B2 prints 2 nonresident first-time first-year students while C1 shows 14 international enrollees. GPA shown is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11. Undergraduate enrollment 31,586 and 974 nonresident undergraduates are the B1 total and the B2 'total undergraduates' column.
